notes:
Summary: Enterprise customer building a ticket-deflection RAG pipeline embedded into their support agent. Primary concerns: indexing scale (~12M support artifacts initially, expected to grow to 40M in 12 months), strict latency SLOs (p95 end-to-end <120ms for top-5 results), and cost per query target (<$0.003 total for embed+search+rerank).

Details & customer voice: - "Customer wants 'instant' feel; ops team says p95 <=120ms or they won't route to live agent.
- They prioritize top-5 quality for suggested article rerank (manual QA: need >85% helpful on top-5).
- Prefer opens models/Redwood-verified model variants for cost control; willing to run Dedicated or Private for residency.

Technical constraints & preferences: - Index: currently 12M unique ticket+kb documents, avg doc length 400 tokens; upstream growth estimate x3 in 12 months.
- Query load: baseline 150 QPS peak (biz hours), planning for 300 QPS in peak season.
- Embeddings: want lower-cost 8-bit quantized embeddings if accuracy holds; exploring batched async embed pipelines.
- Rerank: two-stage search (approx. ANN top-100 -> lightweight reranker for top-5); reranker latency budget = 20-30ms per query on Dedicated.
- Cache: strong interest in prefix/KV cache to hit SLOs for repeat queries.

POC notes and metrics observed: - Baseline POC (hosted embeddings + Redwood small reranker): avg latency 95ms, p95 220ms (problematic), cost ~ $0.007/query.
- Main variance source: cold KV cache misses and reranker compute oversubscription on longer contexts.
- SE suggestion: Dedicated with prewarm, persistent KV cache, and model quantization to reduce per-query cost to target.

Commercial & procurement: - Interested in 12 month reserved Dedicated commit if POC meets p95 and cost targets.
- Legal: wants EU data residency for EU customers; okay to keep US customer data in public cloud but EU tickets must stay in EU region.

Action items: - SE to run 72hr benchmark on Dedicated (multi-region) with KV caching enabled (Marcus).
- Engineering to produce cost projection with batching and quantization (Alicia + Optimize team).
- Customer to provide sample redaction rules and retention policy for legal review.

Stated quote from product lead: 'If we can get p95 under 120ms and keep price near $0.0025/q, this becomes our default deflection path.'

use_case_requirements: - Top-5 rerank quality >=85% helpful (manual eval). - End-to-end p95 <120ms for served top-5. - Index scale: initial 12M documents -> plan for 40M in 12 months. - Query peak: 150 QPS baseline, 300 QPS seasonal. - Cost target: < $0.003 per query (embed + search + rerank). - Support SSO/SAML, SOC2 and EU data residency. - Prefer Dedicated or Private with optional burst to hosted for overflow.
architecture_notes: Proposed architecture: Async batched embedding pipeline -> vector store sharded by region -> ANN layer (HNSW / IVF) -> KV/prefix cache for hot queries -> Redwood reranker as second-stage. Suggested Dedicated pool with reserved GPU T4/RTX nodes for reranker, autoscale for embedding batch jobs. Consider quantized model variants for embedder and reranker to hit cost targets.
